about: X.W11.rel1 (value.js COHESION §0gb.2 ESC-W11c-RELEASE-TEST-RED; W11.md ADDENDUM (third)): THE ONE committed manifest of producer-held vitest cases. Each row is a test whose cure is glass-ui's to ship, relayed by its O-id. test/ink.test.ts registers exactly these full names through its one helper, which runs the unchanged body and passes only if the body throws an AssertionError: any other error fails it, a body that passes fails it (glass landed: adopt it and delete the row), and a row that matches no registered test fails the file. Every other failure blocks. A row leaves only by adoption, and expires at its stated repin.
